Name: Anah
Summary: Anah was a child of Zibeon the Horite, and the parent of Dishon and Aholibamah.
KeyStory: Anah is remembered for finding hot springs in the wilderness while feeding his father Zibeon's donkeys.
RelatedPeople: Zibeon; Dishon, Son of Anah; Aholibamah
LifeLesson: Even a small discovery in the wilderness earned Anah a place in the record.
